topic.title: Select a Working Copy
topic.shortdesc: Select the local Git repository that you want to use in the Git Staging view.

body.p:
To select a working copy from your file system, click the Browse button to the right of the Working copy combo box. The selected folder must be a Git repository.
When a working copy is opened, the Git Client automatically detects outdated local branches in the background. These are branches linked to remote branches that no longer exist. In this situation, a warning dialog box shows the outdated local branches and gives you the option to delete them.
The outdated local branch detection also runs periodically after a working copy is loaded, every 3.5 hours.
If the current branch is detected as outdated, you must switch to another branch before you can delete it.
